recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中，在含鐵血黃素棕色顆粒與紅系前驅細胞之間，散在較大的上皮樣細胞，核大、泡狀、形狀不規則、核仁不明顯，細胞質淡染至粉紅；本例經 CD163 證實為組織球而非轉移癌。
features: Hypercellular marrow with scattered large epithelioid cells showing enlarged, oval to irregular vesicular nuclei and inconspicuous nucleoli
Epithelioid cells have moderate to abundant pale/clear to lightly eosinophilic cytoplasm with ill-defined borders
Abundant coarse golden-brown pigment (hemosiderin) within macrophages
Background of erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei and myeloid cells between adipocytes
No discrete cohesive glandular nests or desmoplasia evident in this field
describe_en: High-power view of an H&E-stained bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with maturing erythroid and myeloid elements and abundant hemosiderin-laden macrophages. Interspersed are large epithelioid cells with pleomorphic vesicular nuclei, inconspicuous nucleoli, and pale to pink cytoplasm, which form a loose focal aggregate rather than cohesive glands. On H&E alone these cells raise concern for metastatic carcinoma; however, in this case they showed only dot-like cytoplasmic keratin staining with membranous CD163 positivity, supporting an epithelioid histiocytic aggregate in a marrow with MDS. The epithelioid focus is not sharply delineated at this magnification, so correlation with the lower-power and immunostained panels is required.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma forms cohesive nests with strong diffuse cytoplasmic/membranous keratin and is CD163/CD68 negative, whereas these cells show only dot-like keratin and membranous CD163.
Granulomas are compact with elongated slipper-shaped nuclei, multinucleated giant cells, and a lymphoid cuff, and warrant AFB/fungal stains.
Mast cell aggregates contain spindled or oval cells with pale granular cytoplasm, often paratrabecular or perivascular with eosinophils and fibrosis, and are CD117/tryptase positive.
Megakaryocytes are larger with lobulated or hypolobated hyperchromatic nuclei and are CD61/CD42b positive.
